title: The Owl Who Wouldn't Divide
story: Petrahoot the Stone Owl guards a quarry vault of recovered wages and insists the 14 quarry workers can never be paid fairly, because 'stone does not split evenly.' The vault holds 8 bars of silver, and each bar is worth 63 coins. Mr 6 taps the vault door and smiles.
question: If 8 bars worth 63 coins each are shared equally among 14 workers, how many coins does each worker receive?
hint: First find the total value of all 8 bars, then split that total into 14 equal shares.
victory: Mr 6 proved every worker got exactly 36 coins with nothing left over, and Petrahoot — who had bet a feather on it being impossible — hooted once and turned into a very fair-minded statue.
imagePrompt: A huge stone owl perched atop an iron vault in a moonlit quarry, silver bars gleaming inside while a numeral-six knight chalks a division onto the rock face for a crowd of weary workers.
